“大少爷我不是那个意思。”陆大鹏吓得赶紧否认，“我只是想说，大少爷告诉我一声，我也好给大少爷接风洗尘。”

陆大鹏内心满是忐忑和恐慌，这煞星在国外待得好好的，回来做什么啊！！

陆家乃百年望族，家规森严，别看陆清韵叫他一声二叔，可他不过是陆家的旁支，而面前这位，却是陆家正儿八经的嫡系，这些年陆家嫡系已经撤出了国内，不知道他回来做什么……

“那就不必了。”陆清韵目光落在时笙身上。

时笙立即扬起一抹笑容，金主啊，这是未来的金主，不能得罪。

林姗姗早就看痴了，这个圈子里，估计都找不出比眼前这个男人还帅的人，听陆大鹏的称呼，身份比他还尊贵，若是能攀上这样的人物……

想到这里，林姗姗立即打消了这个念头，眼底的痴迷也慢慢褪去。

这个男人一看就不是那么好相处的，能让陆大鹏这么低三下气的人物，哪儿是她能惹的，还不如好好守着陆大鹏，免得得不偿失。

林姗姗无疑是有自知之明的，但是她一抬头，就看到时笙对着那个男人笑，而那个男人竟然朝着她走了过去。

见此，林姗姗更是恨时笙了，她凭什么！！

“金……陆先生巧啊！”时笙眉眼弯弯的打招呼。

陆大鹏见陆清韵竟然冲时笙点了点头，当即吓得魂都飞了，不是说江晚只是个普通人吗？怎么和这个煞星认识？

“陆二叔还有事？”陆清韵在时笙身边站定，侧目扫向僵着身子不敢动的陆大鹏。

陆大鹏浑身一颤，连连摇头，“没事没事，那大少爷，我就先走了。”

陆大鹏拉着林姗姗，转身就往门外走，连酒会都不参加了。

妈的，煞星在这里，他不想活了才进去。

“等等。”

陆大鹏脚步一顿，转过身，恭敬又忐忑的道：“大少爷还有什么吩咐？”

“道歉。”

道歉？陆大鹏整个人都不好了，江晚和这个煞星什么关系？竟然能让他开口！！

陆大鹏冷汗涔涔的看了眼江晚，直接弯腰，“江小姐，刚才是我的错，你大人有大量，别和我一般计较。我和你无冤无仇，都是林姗姗撺掇我，我这才猪油蒙了心……”

林姗姗脸色煞白，她哪里想到，这陆大鹏这么轻易就把自己卖了。

“陆大鹏，你这是什么意思？”他害怕这个男人，所以就要把错全推到她身上？

“闭嘴。”陆大鹏满脸狠厉的呵斥林姗姗一声，要不是她，他根本不会正眼看江晚，更不会因为她得罪这个煞星。

“怎么做，不用我教你吧？”

“是是，大少爷放心，我一定会处理好的。”

"Young Master, I didn't mean that." Lu Dapeng was so frightened that he quickly denied, "I just wanted to say that the Young Master told me so that I could help him."

Lu Dapeng's heart was full of anxiety and panic. This evil star was staying abroad well, what would he do when he came back?!

The Lu family is a century-old family with strict family rules. Although Lu Qingyun calls him second uncle, he is just a branch of the Lu family, and the person in front of him is a direct descendant of the Lu family. In recent years, the direct descendants of the Lu family have withdrawn from the country. I don’t know what he will do when he comes back...

"That's not necessary." Lu Qingyun's eyes fell on Shi Sheng.

Shi Sheng immediately raised a smile and said, funder, this is the future funder and cannot be offended.

Lin Shanshan has been obsessed with it for a long time. In this circle, there is probably no one more handsome than the man in front of her. According to Lu Dapeng's name, his status is more noble than him. If he can climb up to such a person...

Thinking of this, Lin Shanshan immediately gave up the idea, and the obsession in her eyes slowly faded away.

This man is not so easy to get along with at first glance. She can't offend someone like Lu Dapeng who can make him so humiliated. She might as well guard Lu Dapeng to avoid losing more than the gain.

Lin Shanshan was undoubtedly self-aware, but when she looked up, she saw Shi Sheng smiling at the man, and the man actually walked towards her.

Seeing this, Lin Shanshan hated Shi Sheng even more. Why should she!!

"Jin... Mr. Lu, what a coincidence!" Shi Sheng greeted with a crooked eyebrow.

When Lu Dapeng saw Lu Qingyun actually nodded to Shi Sheng, he was so frightened that he was scared out of his wits. Didn't he say that Jiang Wan was just an ordinary person?How did you get to know this evil star?

"Second Uncle Lu, is there anything else?" Lu Qingyun stood beside Shi Sheng and glanced sideways at Lu Dapeng, who was frozen and did not dare to move.

Lu Dapeng trembled all over and shook his head repeatedly, "It's okay, it's okay. Then, young master, I'll leave first."

Lu Dapeng took Lin Shanshan, turned around and walked out the door, not even attending the cocktail party.

Damn it, the evil star is here, he didn't want to live before he went in.

"Wait."

Lu Dapeng paused, turned around, and said respectfully and anxiously: "Young master, what else do you have to say?"

"Apologise."

Apologize?Lu Dapeng was in bad shape. What was the relationship between Jiang Wan and this evil star?It actually made him speak!!

Lu Dapeng glanced at Jiang Wan with cold sweat, and bent down directly, "Miss Jiang, it was my fault just now. You have a lot, so don't argue with me. I have no enmity with you, it was Lin Shanshan who encouraged me, and now I have lost my mind..."

Lin Shanshan's face turned pale. She never thought that Lu Dapeng would sell her out so easily.

"Lu Dapeng, what do you mean?" He was afraid of this man, so he wanted to put all the blame on her?

"Shut up." Lu Dapeng scolded Lin Shanshan sternly. If it hadn't been for her, he would never have looked at Jiang Wan, let alone offended this evil star because of her.

"How to do it, you don't need me to teach you, right?"

"Yes, yes, don't worry, young master, I will definitely handle it."
